scope: One matched real XTerm 1080p scroll pair comparing NVENC HEVC 4:4:4 CBR and lossless on two owned X11 endpoints.
measurement_limits: Each arm uses a 30-second warmup and 60-second scored window per phase. One pair cannot estimate across-run variance. Static metrics measure a selected glyph mask and crop. Settling uses the first final marker observed on each endpoint clock, and does not time transit from source to viewer, or physical display response.

workload.action: scroll up one row and insert new Unicode text beneath a fixed marker row

manifest.source: Mint xterm scroll source and X11 root capture
manifest.target: owned Ubuntu X11 viewer, HEVC 4:4:4 at 1:1

trials.scope: independent X11 software raster observations on separate machines over OpenSSH
